name: usage-coach
description: Pro-plan weekly-limit coach: status line "wk 53% · 5.7d · ~8.2%/day", an amber band when today's spend beats the daily allowance or more than 3 sessions run in parallel, /budget, /next and a task queue (tasks.md) with measured cost per task.
